description: The shared libraries an ELF file of the Linux AppImage may need without the image carrying them: the recipient's own. Everything else a bundled ELF file needs must be in the image. tools/build/check-elf-needed-closure.cjs reads this file; a library added here needs a reason a reviewer can check, because the image then stops being self-contained for it.

baseline.musl: unsupported: a musl system (Alpine) cannot run glibc programs; the AppImage's AppRun preflight refuses it in the user's language (startup.linux_appimage_musl_body).

groups.reason: One glibc installation, loader included. It cannot be bundled piecemeal: the loader, libc and the recipient's GTK, GL and NSS modules must agree. The image is built on the oldest supported LTS instead, and check-elf-glibc-ceiling.cjs refuses a newer symbol version.
The recipient's GTK stack links its own GLib and C++ runtime; a bundled older copy shadows them and the tray fails to load (see stage-linux-network-runtime.py recipient_base).

The libraries the recipient's GLib loads itself (libgio needs libz, libgobject needs libffi). stage-linux-network-runtime.py recipient_dependencies leaves them out so the image never shadows the recipient's newer copies, so the bundled curl, libcurl, librtmp, libssh and libp11-kit use the recipient's: every system that runs the tray has them.
The tray library and the webview windows load the recipient's GTK 3 into the daemon's process; the image bundles only the tray's own libraries without GTK.

never_bundled.reason: Libraries and data that load into, or must match, the recipient's GLib and GTK inside the daemon. GIO_MODULE_DIR pointed the recipient's GLib at the bundled modules, and on Arch (GLib 2.86) the Ubuntu 22.04 libdconfsettings.so crashed luajit (SEGV_MAPERR) before any window opened. The image uses the recipient's GIO modules (glib-networking, dconf, libproxy) and schemas (gsettings-desktop-schemas) instead. tools/build/check-elf-needed-closure.cjs and stage-linux-network-runtime.py refuse a tree that carries one, and any library of a group above.

host_requirements.reason: What the image deliberately takes from the recipient beyond the shared libraries above: the network features need a GIO proxy resolver and its schema, and the tray prefers the recipient's libayatana (the image's copy in usr/lib/tray is only a fallback for a recipient without one).
